explanation_full: The residual analysis chart indicates that the KNN model is the best performer among the tested algorithms, boasting an R2 score of 0.8172. This metric suggests that the model explains a high proportion of the variance in the data compared to other models like RF (R2=0.7756) and XGBoost (R2=0.7495). Furthermore, the low RMSE (0.1132) and MAE (0.075) for KNN suggest that its predictions are consistently close to the actual values, confirming its superior predictive capability for HPR.
